notes.title: Mod: Custom Characters and Weapons
notes.content:
We are developing new features with mods =)

* Mods aren't platform dependent, so will work out of the box on windows, mac, and linux/steamos.
* Adding new characters should be extremely easy. Character selection screen will change to a scrolling list to fit more.
* Custom map generation is definitely one of the most ambitious portions of the modding plans.

notes.title: Update #10 Cross-platform Multiplayer
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-iWg_pvIbaY

We recorded a video showing a game play. Check out !

We signed a plan with Photon Engine (Photon Unity) to provide true cross-platform functionality, where you can play with a pc or mobiles devices with your friends.

Features
- Full Controller Support;
- Online Cross-platform Multiplayer
- Online Chat (Cross-platform)
- Randomly-generated levels, enemies and itens
- Mini and Big Bosses
- Modes: Adventure, Survival (Arena, Capture the Flag, Death Match coming soon) 

Massive game was published in GameTube ( 145.357 viewers =)
https://www.facebook.com/gametb/posts/584685585038779

Gameplay Level 2 - Update #1.0.3
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gAWKk67sYIs

Big Bulltets - Big Boss #1
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=veFRvgFGzpk

Enjoy =)

- Online Cross-platform Multiplayer
- Online Chat (Cross-platform)
- Randomly-generated levels, enemies and itens

notes.title: #Update 1.0.1 - Fixed Sound Bug!
notes.content:
"Ｔｅｎｓｅｎｕｍａ" reported a problem with sounds and we checked programming code
We found a sound bug!
Instead of using PlayOneShot() function, we used Play() and this really bugged sounds.

We recorded a video with this bug fixed. Now the sounds are working correctly.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hLT7rjjvXQE&feature=youtu.be
